title: Overly Sweet Dutch Treacle Pudding
description: A traditional Dutch dessert typically served on special occasions, made with a sweet and sticky treacle topping over a light and airy pudding.
instructions:
Preheat the oven to 1809C (350).
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour and butter and mix until a crumbly dough forms.
Add the baking powder, salt, and milk to the dough and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Pour the batter into a greased 20cm (8 inch) copper pot.
Place the pot in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the pot.
Bake for 45 minutes.
While the pudding is baking, combine the treacle, golden syrup, and heavy cream in a small saucepan and heat over low heat, stirring occasionally, until smooth and warm.
Remove the pudding from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the pudding warm with the treacle topping spooned over the top.
